notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped multi-attribute update and retraction surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, multi-attribute FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies passel-level timestamped reflection and suppression of a retracted queued update without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped UpdateAttributeValues and Retract with FederateAmbassador timestamped reflect callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped attribute update/retraction and FederateAmbassador reflection declarations
